name: Spherical Harmonics Degree 0 Color Reconstruction
definition: Reconstructs the base color of a 3D Gaussian splat from its stored spherical harmonic coefficient (SH0) by applying a constant scaling factor, bias, and range clamping, followed by color space decoding if required.
summary: Spherical Harmonics Degree 0 Color Reconstruction extracts a uniform, direction-independent diffuse color from zeroth-order coefficients to support fallback rendering in viewers lacking full Gaussian Splatting support.
